standards.text: traits are passed from parents to offspring through genes, and that variations in DNA result in observable differences among individuals and populations;
natural variation in inherited traits contributes to biodiversity, and that endemic organisms play important roles in maintaining ecosystems and supporting community life; and
biotechnology, supported by digital tools for analyzing biological information, is applied in everyday life to improve human health, food production, and community well-being.
natural resources are essential for daily living and that sustainable practices help reduce environmental impact and ensure resource availability for present and future needs;
human activities release pollutants and greenhouse gases that contribute to climate change, which affects ecosystems and communities at local and global levels;
space technologies, including satellites and space probes, provide important data that help scientists understand Earth’s systems, environmental changes, and the universe;

The learners can design practical and simple solutions or awareness activities that demonstrate understanding of heredity, biodiversity, and biotechnology and their applications in improving everyday life in the community.

The learners can design and communicate simple, evidence-based explanations or proposals that demonstrate understanding of environmental sustainability, climate change, and the role of space technologies in monitoring Earth and improving daily life.
